load_COCOVQA_data_list: load the COCOVQA data list by calling load_data_list to get questions and annotations
create_COCOVQA_image_index: create an image index mapping 12-digit image IDs to file paths using _create_image_index
review_COCOVQA_answer_weighting: review the COCOVQA class and how it computes answer weights using Counter for duplicate answers
join_COCOVQA_question_prefix: join the question file path with data_root using _join_prefix when path is relative
